retrievalProfile.description: A layered composition featuring a subject reflected in a chalkboard surface covered in dense, cursive handwriting with studio equipment visible.
excludeWhen: modern high-tech studio environments are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual stack where a green chalkboard serves as both a writing surface and a reflective mirror, showing a man in a red shirt writing on the glass/board, while a white photography umbrella and handwritten cursive text occupy the mid-ground and foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in red reflected in the bottom right corner
White studio umbrella reflected in the top right corner
Dense cursive handwriting spanning the central vertical axis
Bold sans-serif title text positioned along the top and left edges
coreInvariants: High-contrast red clothing on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is positioned in the lower right quadrant, appearing at roughly 1/4 scale of the total frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white photography umbrella in the upper right provides a bright, geometric anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the vertical title on the left, moves across the top title, descends through the handwritten block, and settles on the subject in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides the most breathing room, though it is still textured by the chalkboard surface.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red (subject's shirt and display typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red accents contrasts sharply against the desaturated, matte green background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to green, red, white, and natural wood tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and natural cursive script
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy, uniform stroke weights with no serifs
Body text is authentic, slanted cursive with varying pressure
Chalk-like texture with soft edges and internal grain
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '+' symbol is used as a prefix to the main title
Vertical orientation for the secondary display text on the left margin
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial geometric sans-serif paired with intimate, personal handwriting.

preserve: The red color of the display text
The vertical orientation of the side text
The chalky texture of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric simplicity of the display text
Required for the authentic 'written on board' look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a green chalkboard reflecting a man in a red turtleneck in the bottom right and a white studio umbrella in the top right. The board should have visible smudges and a metal frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large block of white cursive handwriting across the center of the board. Add bold red sans-serif title text at the top and vertically along the left edge, preceded by a red plus sign.

verificationChecks: Is the subject in the bottom right wearing red?
Is the handwriting texture consistent with chalk?
Is the title text bold red and sans-serif?
Is the studio umbrella visible in the reflection?

mustRedesign: Ensure the text content is original and not a direct copy of the source
Remove any specific brand logos from the studio equipment

mustAchieve: Balanced use of the red accent

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text on the left is readable bottom-to-top or top-to-bottom.
Ensure the white umbrella does not blow out the highlights too much.
Verify the handwriting overlaps the subject's reflection naturally.
Confirm the green background has a matte, slate-like finish.
recipe.reuseFormula: Reflective [Surface Material] + [Subject in High Contrast Color] Reflection + [Handwritten Script Overlay] + [Bold Geometric Display Type]
